transcript:
This message comes from Schwab. At Schwab, you can get everything from self-directed investing to full-service wealth management, all in one place.
No matter your investing goal, life stage, amount to invest, or know-how, you can invest your way with Schwab.
According to a statement from Oregon last night, they were there to mourn a deadly school shooting.
Authorities say three children and a teacher were killed yesterday in the shooting at an elementary school.
Police say the shooter was a 16-year-old male. He was shot and killed by a bystander who pursued him into the school.
Ukraine has fired on a major Russian oil refinery. This comes after President Trump claimed there was an energy ceasefire in place between Ukraine and Russia.
Ukraine had stopped firing on Russian energy targets for a few days. NPR's Charles Mains says the Ukrainian attack is sending a message.
This attack occurred after Ukrainian President Vladimir Zelensky said he was "done," trying to abide by Trump's energy ceasefire, given that Russia had never ceased its attacks on Ukrainian electrical and heating infrastructure.
NPR's Charles Mains reporting. Immigration agents seized Minnesota Democratic Congresswoman Ilhan Omar's personal documents and devices.
NPR's Luke Garrett reports Omar was home during the surge this week.
Rep. Omar's phone, personal computer, passport and notebooks were all taken by federal agents on Monday, according to a person familiar with the case, but not authorized to share details publicly.
Homeland Security investigation agents searched her D.C. home as part of what the Justice Department calls a federal criminal investigation.
A government official, who spoke on the condition of anonymity because they're not authorized to discuss the case, tells NPR that the Congresswoman was at her D.C. home during the execution of the search warrant, but was not detained during the hours-long visit.
Since Monday, members of Omar's family have been subpoenaed in a case that centers on immigration fraud allegations.
Omar has long denied these claims and calls the search of her D.C. home political targeting.
Luke Garrett, NPR News, Washington.
A group of swing voters in Georgia, who had supported President Trump in 2024, has largely changed its view of him.
Members of the group say their frustration and disappointment is influencing who they vote for during this year's midterm elections.
NPR's Ashley Lopez prepared this report.
NPR observed focus groups with 12 voters in Georgia who voted for President Biden in 2020 and Trump in 2024. 11 now say they disapprove of the overall job Trump has been doing, and 10 say they regret voting for him.
Cynthia, an independent voter who participated under the condition her last name would not be used, says this frustration is affecting how she's going to vote.
People that are aligned closely with him, I would not vote for because I haven't supported what he's done so far. And like I said, it's been a very big disappointment.
So I would probably lean toward people that are not aligned with him to vote for.
Many said they hope a mix of power in Washington will create some stability. Ashley Lopez, NPR News.
You're listening to NPR News from Washington.
Pakistan is ordering engineers to inspect all of the country's school buildings.
That's after a school building collapsed this week, killing more than 30 people. Nearly all of them were children.
There are reports in Pakistan that say some of the children's relatives had previously warned there were leaks in the building.
Electric automaker Tesla has unveiled a new sports car. The EV uses built-in thrusters to leap over obstacles, and it can go from zero to 60 in under one second.
NPR's John Ruich has the details.
The Tesla Roadster is a collaboration between Tesla and SpaceX, and CEO Elon Musk unveiled it at a SpaceX rocket test center in Texas.
It has 10 built-in nozzles that use ultra-high pressure air that can propel the car down the road or make it jump into the air and do a barrel roll.
It also has fans that can push it down toward the road for better traction.
Tesla has been investing in self-driving technology, and Musk said the Roadster would eventually be the only manually driven car in the lineup.
The angular sports car, he said, is better than any James Bond car and will enter production in 2028.
He added, though, that it's not necessarily safety optimized and might not be legal.
John Ruich, NPR News.
The National Retail Federation is projecting that consumers in the United States will spend more this year on holiday shopping.
That's despite growing inflation and consumers who report more trouble affording the cost of goods and services.
The retail organization estimates shoppers will spend more than $1 trillion for the holidays.
This is NPR.

topics.text: School shooting at an Oregon elementary school kills three children and a teacher; 16-year-old shooter killed by bystander
Ukraine fires on a major Russian oil refinery after Trump claimed an energy ceasefire was in place
Immigration agents seize Rep. Ilhan Omar's phone, passport, and notebooks in federal search of her D.C. home
Georgia swing voters who backed Trump in 2024 now largely disapprove of him ahead of midterms
Pakistan orders inspections of all school buildings after collapse kills more than 30, mostly children
Tesla unveils Roadster sports car with built-in thrusters, co-developed with SpaceX, entering production in 2028
National Retail Federation projects U.S. holiday shopping spending will rise above $1 trillion this year
